name: Symphony Ltd
title: Symphony Ltd - 517385 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Symphony's Q4 consol revenue fell to ₹338 crore from ₹488 crore and FY26 PAT was negative ₹141 crore after a ₹259 crore Australia impairment, while standalone gross margin held near 45%+ and management says it will stop funding Australia.

triggers.label: No further capital to Australia
triggers.quote: no further capital investment or allocation will be made to Australia business

triggers.label: Channel inventory overhang in North and East
triggers.quote: channel inventories to a major extent have already been rationalized

triggers.label: Standalone revenue ₹765 cr from ₹1,182 cr
triggers.quote: Revenue is ₹765 crores, down from ₹1,182 crores

triggers.label: Cost increase to be passed on
triggers.quote: Cost increase will be passed on.

guidance.value: 4 to 6 weeks of decent summer sales
guidance.quote: we have a runway of 4 to 6 weeks of decent summer sales

guidance.value: entire price increase passed from 1 July
guidance.quote: we will be in a position to pass entire price increase in one way or other way

red_flags.label: Standalone EBITDA margin ~17% vs ~27% prior year
red_flags.quote: on a standalone level is 17 %, which year before it's about 27 %

red_flags.label: Summer-dependent weakness; no numeric growth guide
red_flags.quote: if you can give me for next 2, 3 weeks, what's going to be the precise weather

red_flags.label: Australia impairment ₹259 cr; PAT negative ₹141 cr
red_flags.quote: the PAT stands at negative ₹141 crores

evasions.quote: at the right time, Board will consider as it was done in the past
if you can give me for next 2, 3 weeks, what's going to be the precise weather
We don't have separate data right now.
